FestPass project brief
Programme
Team Lantern is building FestPass for Campus Build Sprint 2026, the two-week programme run
by the
college Innovation Cell.
Faculty coordinator: Prof. Meera Kulkarni, Innovation Cell.
Problem
Registrations for Autumn Fest still run on paper forms and group-chat polls. Students register
twice
for the same event, forms go missing, and organisers can't tell how many seats are left until the
doors open.
Goals
• A student can find an event and register in under a minute.
• Every registration produces a QR pass that volunteers scan at the door.
• Organisers see a live seat count for each event.
Team
Ananya Iyer, Rohan Mehta, Ishita Rao and Dev Malhotra, all second-year students.
Timeline
Final submissions close on 20 September 2026.
Budget
Budget cap: ₹50,000 (Innovation Cell grant).
Out of scope
Payments for paid workshops, and events outside Autumn Fest.

## Decisions
- Deadline confirmed as 2026-09-22 (per the organiser email).
- Portal API limit is now 60 rpm, so we cache the event list for five minutes.
- Deployment owner: Ishita Rao (takes over from Rohan, who moves to the payment gateway).
- Budget: follow budget sheet v2.

- Team lead, brief and budget sheet: Ananya Iyer
- Backend and Events Portal integration: Rohan Mehta
- Deployment and AWS account: Rohan Mehta
- Frontend: Ishita Rao
- QA and meeting notes: Dev Malhotra
- Faculty coordinator (Innovation Cell): Prof. Meera Kulkarni
- Student coordinator (Innovation Cell): Sana Sheikh

## Notes
- AWS hosting covers the API, the database and the static site for the fest weeks.
- SMS credits pay for one-time passwords at registration.
- Badge printing is for volunteers and speakers; students use the QR pass on their phones.

## Action items
- Ishita: move the staging stack to her AWS profile and update the runbook.
- Rohan: spike the payment gateway sandbox and report back at Sync 6.
- Dev: add a test for the cached event list expiring after five minutes.
- Ananya: share the updated brief with Prof. Kulkarni once the demo flow is stable.

## Events Portal
FestPass reads event data from the college Events Portal with the team's API key.

Events Portal API rate limit: 100 requests per minute per team API key.

## Payloads
Request bodies stay under 4 KB. A registration carries the student's roll number, name, email and the
event ID. Pass images are generated on request and never stored.
